payload.summary: Teaching Assessments magic links: retire the old PUT registration route and process-memory store, and purge completed or expired links
payload.detail: Follow-up carried from #MAAXAX (closed 26 Oct 2026). src/app/api/teaching/assessments/respond/[token]/route.ts still has the PUT registration path and the in-memory store fallback. Retire them once nothing uses them, and consider a retention purge for completed or expired rows in public.teaching_epa_magic_links. A purge is a database change, so it needs Josh's own yes.
